messages:
Nora (CEO): opening a concise follow-up thread for anything we missed in today's all-hands on mission, positioning, and competitive focus. short Qs pls.
Ezra - Head of Product: very quick  which single message should we lead with externally? has to be one line.
Nora (CEO): "Run any model reliably at production scale." keep it simple and unambiguous.
Lina (Strategy): add a supporting sentence for decks?
Nora (CEO): sure: "Predictable latency, transparent unit economics, and deployment flexibility." one sentence under the headline.
Marco (Sales): practical: SDRs need a 12s rebuttal to "Why not just use cloud endpoints?"
Jade (Marketing): draft SDR line: "Cloud providers expose models; Redwood guarantees production behavior, controls, and predictable cost." short handoff to AE with benchmark.
Kai (Eng): ops question: should we publish the fallback chain publicly or keep private for customers? some worry about giving away behavior to competitors.
Nora (CEO): publish a high-level degradation matrix publicly and more detailed, customer-specific plans behind NDA. transparency for trust; details per account as needed.
Ezra - Head of Product: roadmap alignment  priority order this quarter: 1) reliability SLOs, 2) Optimize tooling (cost controls), 3) Dedicated/Private expansions. confirm?
Nora (CEO): correct. reliability first so customers can trust rollouts. Optimize then Dedicated.
Marco (Sales): any guidance for qualifying low-price buyers vs buyers who value SLAs? quick qualification question?
Lina (Strategy): ask early: "Is predictable latency or lowest price the top priority for your team?" if price -> Optimize demo; if latency/SLA -> Dedicated/Private discussion.
Jade (Marketing): can we get a small set of benchmark cards (1-pagers) for: latency SLO case, cost delta example, and portability note? sales needs them by EOW.
Nora (CEO): yes. Marketing + Product to deliver 3x one-pagers. owner: Jade + Ezra. due EOW.
Kai (Eng): engineering ask: naming convention for model variants (quantized/pruned/etc.)? customers confused by inconsistent labels.
Ezra - Head of Product: we'll publish a simple convention: <model-name>@<variant> (e.g., redwood-13b@q4_0). Docs team will update references.
Marco (Sales): competitor quick-rebuttal when prospects say "we already use X provider for endpoints": "Complement, not replace. We make those endpoints production-grade with controls & economics"
Lina (Strategy): also call out multi-region routing + deterministic fallbacks as a succinct differentiator.
Nora (CEO): final: we'll track three public metrics: median 99p latency by model class, unit cost per 1k tokens for standard tasks, and percent of production apps on Dedicated/Private. we'll share dashboards weekly.
ops-bot: task-created: "one-pagers + degradation matrix + variant naming" assigned to Jade/Ezra/Kai; due 2026-04-02.
Nora (CEO): thanks everyone  keep follow-ups short here or DM owners. closing thread. :v:
